newsitem.title: CHILE: Escondida cumulative copper output rises 11.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Escondida cumulative copper output rises 11.2 percent.

text.p: Chile's Minera Escondida Ltda said on Monday it had produced 63,233 tonnes of copper in July and a total of 543,581 tonnes in the first seven months of 1997, a rise of 11.2 percent.
Escondida, which last year passed Codelco's Chuquicamata mine as the world's largest copper pit, is owned by Australia's Broken Hill Proprietary and RTZ Corp plc.
